regionOrderNote: Canonical region order (north to south, islands last). Same order as content.json regions[]. Use it for region lists, chip lists and for ordering a dish's variations.

insets.bal: Illes Balears: 2x2 block off the Valencian coast

exclavesNote: Ceuta (K) and Melilla (W) are single squares across the sea from Andalucía. They are part of Andalucía: tapping either selects 'and' and they highlight with it. Leave them out of the label centroid so the Andalucía label stays on the mainland. Accessible names: 'Ceuta (Andalucía)' / 'Melilla (Andalucía)'.
labelNudgeUnit: grid cells, added to the centroid of the region cells (x, y)
